messages.subject: The location parameters....
parts:
Hey everyone, with the location parameters on the micro_climate model, will it take into account the noise produced by roads etc?

I will be using the ectotherm model too and was wondering if i choose a location next to a busy motorway/ freeway/ highway will it show a change in the species activity levels or will i have to make some code to produce this?


Sorry if it's a silly question, I'm very new to this and using it for my thesis.

Many thanks to whoever helps it is appreciated:)

messages.author: 6cec8ea3702ece93
messages.subject: Re: The location parameters....
parts:
Hi Ben,
No it will just calculate the heat and water exchange based on the translation into microclimate of whatever the climate and terrain/soil properties you use. You could account for the specific properties of a road and try to predict road temperature compared to adjacent soil, but that would be through how you set up the thermal properties of the 'soil' in the microclimate model. In essence, these models can tell you the potential body temperatures and water loss rates your animal might have in a given location, which you can then use to understand what microclimates it might be selecting (shade, going underground, climbing) and how this would affect its survival, growth and reproduction. For a general intro, have a read of this paper.
All the best,
Mike
